Services

Websites, mobile applications and business tools, designed and built by TSX-MR for businesses and organisations.

Discuss your project

  • Websites

    A clear, fast website that presents your business and makes it easy to reach you.

    • Presentation and business websites
    • Arabic, French and English, right-to-left included
    • Designed for phones first

  • Mobile applications

    An application your customers or your team use on their phones.

    • Android and iPhone from one project
    • Designed for real working conditions
    • Organised around the tasks people do most

  • Business tools

    Software that replaces notebooks and spreadsheets: stock, sales, records and teams.

    • Management and back-office tools
    • Roles and permissions for each person
    • Reports that read at a glance
